hooks.description: Project lifecycle hooks by name: a trusted module reference ({source, export} or a bare path) auth calls at that point. Filters run before the change and may deny it; actions run after the commit. sandbox: true is refused.

abuse.description: Sign-in and sign-up budgets, challenge escalation and password backoff, enforced through the abuse extension. Activation refuses this block when abuse is not installed and active; client budgets need the runtime trusted-proxy boundary (503 trusted_client_required otherwise).

client.description: Budget for every auth entry request (sign-in, sign-up, recovery, email code) per client network: an IPv4 address, or an IPv6 /64.

limit.description: Requests admitted per window for one key; the next one answers 429 with Retry-After.

windowMs.description: Length of the counting window in milliseconds.

signupClient.description: Additional budget for sign-up requests per client network.

limit.description: Requests admitted per window for one key; the next one answers 429 with Retry-After.

windowMs.description: Length of the counting window in milliseconds.

signupDomain.description: Budget for sign-up requests per email domain (the part after @).

limit.description: Requests admitted per window for one key; the next one answers 429 with Retry-After.

windowMs.description: Length of the counting window in milliseconds.

challengeAfter.description: Once the client budget has admitted this many requests in its window, further entry requests must pass the operator challenge (abuse({challenge}) in host.mjs; activation refuses it without one). Requires client and must be below client.limit; a passed challenge never overrides the hard budget.

passwordBackoff.description: Exponential delay per email address after repeated wrong passwords at sign-in or step-up; a blocked address is refused before any password is checked. Bounds match the abuse backoff.

threshold.description: Failures allowed before the first delay (default 5).

initialDelayMs.description: First delay in milliseconds; each further failure doubles it (default 1000).

maxDelayMs.description: Cap on the delay in milliseconds (default 900000); must be at least initialDelayMs.

resetAfterMs.description: Quiet period in milliseconds after which the failure count resets (default 86400000); must be at least maxDelayMs.

role.description: The signed-in account must hold this role.

permission.description: The signed-in account must hold this permission through one of its roles, for example audit.read.

verified.description: true: the account's email address must be verified.

freshWithinSeconds.description: The session must have authenticated within this many seconds (step-up); an older one is denied.

onDeny.description: Answer to a denied request: that status with a JSON error, or sign-in to redirect a GET/HEAD to the login page (other methods then get 401/403). Default: 401 without a session, 403 with one.

csrf.description: How a session write proves same-site intent: token (default) requires auth's session-bound x-csrf-token header or csrf body field; origin admits same-origin provenance with the SameSite=Strict session cookie, for mounts that verify their own token or accept JSON only.

bearer.description: Protect the route with operator-issued API keys (Authorization: Bearer) instead of a session. Exclusive of csrf; the session keys (role, permission, verified, freshWithinSeconds, onDeny) do not apply to a bearer caller.

scopes.description: Scopes the key must hold, all of them; a key missing one answers 403 insufficient_scope. An empty list admits any valid key.

quota.description: Per-key budget on this route, counted by key id in the auth store; over it the request answers 429 credential_quota_exceeded. A key issued with its own quota uses that instead.

requests.description: Requests one key may make per window.

window.description: Window length in seconds (at most 30 days), the units of core policies.throttle.

hooks.name: beforeRegister
hooks.description: Runs before any path creates an account (self-service, provider sign-up, waitlist request, administrator creation, import) and may deny it.

email.description: Normalized email address of the account to be created.

profile.description: Registration profile fields, when the path collects them.

allow.description: false refuses the change with 403 and the reason.

reason.description: Why the change was refused (at most 256 characters, control characters removed); returned with the 403.

hooks.name: beforeRoleChange
hooks.description: Runs before an account's roles change (direct, case, case approval, bulk account operation) and may deny it.

accountId.description: Id of the account whose roles change.

requestedRoles.description: Roles it would hold after the change.

actorId.description: Id of the account making the change.

reason.description: The reason recorded for the change.

allow.description: false refuses the change with 403 and the reason.

reason.description: Why the change was refused (at most 256 characters, control characters removed); returned with the 403.

actorId.description: The administrator who created it, when one did.

hooks.name: onAccountStatusChanged

reason.description: The reason recorded for the change.

hooks.name: onDeletionScheduled
hooks.description: Runs after an account's deletion is scheduled, by its owner (no actorId) or an administrator.

deleteAfter.description: When the purge becomes due, in epoch milliseconds.

actorId.description: The administrator who scheduled it; absent when the owner did.

hooks.name: onAccountDeleted
hooks.description: Runs after a scheduled deletion is purged.

authoring.description: Auth is part of the application, while this package keeps ownership of identity, session, CSRF and recovery behavior. Customize its project configuration and UI surfaces before replacing package behavior.

surfaces.name: registration
surfaces.description: Select the supported registration mode in extensions.auth.config.registration.

surfaces.name: account copy
surfaces.description: Change account-screen wording through the UI catalogue.

surfaces.name: account screens
surfaces.description: Override one auth/* screen when its structure must change; keep form actions and security behavior package-owned.

surfaces.name: account lifecycle
surfaces.description: Use the declared beforeRegister, beforeRoleChange, onAccountCreated, onAccountStatusChanged, onDeletionScheduled and onAccountDeleted hooks; auth fires them for every caller, its pages, administration and its CLI.

surfaces.name: abuse budgets
surfaces.description: Rate-limit entry requests, escalate to a challenge and back off password failures through the abuse extension.

agent.description: Local, revision-pinned references for agents configuring the auth extension.

references.name: auth extension guide
references.description: Configuration, operator setup and route integration guidance; ends with the generated field reference for every configuration key.
